Alright, let me think through this year's plan. I've been working these 12 mu for 30 years, so I know what this land can do.

With just me and my wife at home — the kids are off working in the city — labor is my biggest headache. That's why I keep cotton to only 4 mu. Cotton pays well when prices are decent, but the picking in autumn nearly breaks our backs. The other 8 mu is wheat-maize like most folks around here. That system is reliable, and the maize straw goes back to the field.

**Wheat (8 mu):** I planted in early October last fall, should harvest around June 10th. I put down about 25 kg of compound fertilizer per mu as base before planting, then topdress 15 kg of urea at jointing in late March. That works out to around 17-18 kg N per mu total. The extension fellow at the township station said 15 is enough, but I always do a bit more — my neighbor Old Wang cut back two years ago and his wheat looked yellow, didn't yield well. I'd rather spend the extra 20 yuan per mu than risk it. I'll irrigate three times: overwintering water in December, green-up water in March, and grain-filling water in May. If it rains well I might skip one.

**Maize (8 mu):** Right after wheat harvest, no time to waste — I'll direct-seed into the stubble around June 15th with a hired planter (40 yuan per mu, worth it). Hybrid seed from the agricultural supply shop, Zhengdan or Xianyu variety depending on what's in stock. I put about 30 kg of compound fertilizer per mu at planting and topdress urea 15 kg at the big bell stage. One irrigation at tasseling if July is dry. Should get about 500 kg/mu if the weather behaves.

**Cotton (4 mu):** Plant around April 20th after the soil warms. I use transplanted seedlings from my own seedbed to save on seed cost. About 15 kg N per mu split across base and two topdressings. Two irrigations — one at budding, one at boll-setting. I'll spray for aphids and bollworm probably 4-5 times through the summer. My wife and I pick it ourselves starting in September, might hire a relative for a few days at peak.

Total input cash I need to come up with: roughly 5,000-5,500 yuan. Tight but manageable.
